summary: Correct existing BFF Consultation owner authentication and readback. Wired operator-bff machine token in docker-compose.yml, resolved verified caller tenant using existing OwnerReadContextMiddleware and bound_tenant in owner_reads.py, bound Consultation client with machine auth and verified tenant in operations_consultation.py without swallowing owner errors or falling back to local store, routed Workshop canonical consultation transport through shared ConsultationServiceClient with machine auth and caller tenant, and proved with real in-repo Consultation HTTP owner tests.

verification_proofs.owner_draft_list_and_detail: BFF lists and reads labelled owner DRAFT for verified operator tenant with allowedActions.canCancel=True
verification_proofs.empty_and_missing_isolation: BFF returns empty list and 404 for tenant B with no records; non-existent ID returns genuine 404
verification_proofs.machine_auth_visible_error: Invalid/missing machine token returns visible 403 DOWNSTREAM_AUTH_ERROR without store fallback or false 404
verification_proofs.tenant_mismatch_rejected: Foreign tenant in X-Selected-Tenant or body mismatch rejected with 403 TENANT_MISMATCH before owner call
verification_proofs.outage_and_malformed_visible_error: Connection failure / malformed JSON returns visible 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE without fallback to local store
verification_proofs.workshop_canonical_transport: Workshop canonical consultation transport verified sending machine token and caller tenant, rejecting body mismatch and foreign tenant
